title: storage: a file field's accept / maxSize refusal (FileConstraintError) answers 500 INTERNAL_ERROR instead of a 4xx naming the field and constraint
body:
QA-source: #21720 · attachments-storage.field-accept-maxsize-server-enforced · outside the item's clauses

The item's knownGap predicted this and says to extract it; the 17.7 pre-release run #21720 (subject `251a7dd4`) measured it (lane L6) and verifier V4 reproduced it on two fresh boots: CONFIRMED, P3. Predates 17.6.0.

## Reproduction

Scratch object with `doc: { type: 'file', accept: ['.pdf'], maxSize: 10 }`:

- create a record with a `text/plain` file → **500** `{"error":"Internal server error","code":"INTERNAL_ERROR"}`;
- create one with a 5005-byte PDF → **500**, same body; the log reads `FileConstraintError: File exceeds the maximum size declared for 'doc' (5005 bytes > 10 bytes)`, `code: 'ERR_FILE_CONSTRAINT'`;
- control: a 6-byte PDF → 201. Both refused writes leave no row — enforcement holds; only the wire contract is wrong (no field, no reason, wrong status class).

## Mechanism

`FileConstraintError` (`packages/services/service-storage/src/file-reference-lifecycle.ts:229-234`) declares `code` but no `status`; its sibling `FileFieldBulkWriteError` in the same file declares `status = 400` for exactly this reason.
